summary: @or-sdk/mcp-tools preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated math_init.js payload
details: The package's declared preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks the binary executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line obfuscated bundle (string-array rotation with a large numeric array n7gIxM, rotator function WV8StW, hex-mangled identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, no readable strings or symbols) whose filename does not correspond to the package's advertised MCP-tools purpose. Because npm auto-executes preinstall on `npm install`, the obfuscated payload runs on the installer's machine before any consumer code review is possible. The alternate-runtime fetch is the mechanism that lets the payload target Bun-specific APIs and evade Node-only static analysis; the runtime is fetched specifically to run the obfuscated blob, not to run any shipped, human-readable code of the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
